product_name: ASUS TUF Dash Intel Windows 10 15 FX516PM-AZ154T

reviews.author: Priya d.
jeremy
reviews.text:
Plenty powerful and extremely fast. I7 is powerful enough (even though only 4 cores) and RTX 3060 works great and you will be able to play any modern game at higher to ultra settings at 1080p. You can even use DLSS for better performance and turn on ray tracing if you like. Highlight is the 240hz 100% RGB screen - looks beautiful and worth the extra money. I have heard that the 144hz panel is not that great. Build quality is fantastic and overall looks greats.Please don't compare this to the other gaming laptop of the same price - none of them are as thin and light as this. Perfect for me - I am an IT student and move around a lot but still need something powerful. A light laptop makes a huge difference.If you want something that you will not carry around or if you only care about raw benchmarks and performance, look for something else. But if you want an all-round practical, powerful and premium experience, this will not disappoint!
